title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds at sixty-five thousand seventy-five dollars, up zero point seven percent, even as the Fear and Greed Index sits at thirty. Network strength remains the standout signal, with hashrate steady at nine hundred ninety-three exahashes per second. 

The mempool shows eighty-one thousand pending transactions, yet the fastest fee lingers at just two satoshis per byte, pointing to limited urgency in the queue. Block height has reached nine hundred sixty-one thousand six hundred seventeen.
